profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer with experience in Python, Ruby, Java and related automation languages. I have developed and deployed services using Django, Docker, Kubernetes, Celery/RMQ, and PostgreSQL. My experience also extends to Linux, GitHub, Jenkins, Rancher, and AWS. I hold an active Secret security clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained PaaS applications for long-term trending data, daemon analysis, and data simulation 
Owner and contributor of Django-based services with RESTful API
Cross-team collaboration to identify optimization and feature creation to support client requirements
Contributor on Python library of internal service wrappers
Received ad hoc feature requests and delivered service functionality under tight deadlines
Lead the initiative and development to combine two services into one  
Identified and addressed security vulnerabilities on various deployed services 
Provided troubleshooting support on various software and coding errors for aerospace engineering teams
Peer reviewed code changes across multiple teams
Rotational on-call support for various team services critical to spacecraft health
Supported six satellite launches
Assisted with legacy service migrations for factory deprecation
Translated MATLAB scripts to Python and refactored for optimization
Designed and developed automation test framework (Java/Cucumber)
Contributor to Angular-based test dashboard application
Contributor for Ruby based satellite data simulator
Cross-team collaboration for creating test automation, maintenance, and debugging
Assisted on-prem to cloud migrations

positions.title: Administrative Specialist
positions.description:
Process Code violation notices, schedule code officers’ Blight Hearings and abatements, record vehicle impounds and report to PD
Collaborate with IT to revise/create new workflows and configurations for Code processes in CityView
Test workflow changes in CityView Validation
File and maintain databases of Code violation types, hearings, and impounds
Maintain spreadsheets for monthly and yearly violation reports
Receive complaints from the public via web portal, email, phone, and in-person to input and route to the appropriate officer
Train code officers on new workflows and CityView Mobile
Route reports to other departments if necessary
Maintain updated on any changes to Municipal Code to effectively and accurately answer concerns of the public

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description:
Created and managed test cases with JIRA and QMetry
Manually tested internal applications
Created flowcharts and documentation reflecting internal processes at a high level

positions.title: Elections Specialist
positions.description:
•	Register voters and maintain voter database
•	Run voter reports weekly and send necessary correspondence
•	Cooperate with other teams on elections procedures
•	Create process flowcharts

positions.title: Motor Vehicle Technician
positions.description:

•	Investigate motor vehicle records using multiple applications
